**Finding submitted: deviation (IP), fallback target.**

- **Issue:** Section 13 (p0088) gives Garman ownership of all IP in the Work *including the Modifications and Improvements built for us*, with no title to us. Our only licence (Section 2) is non-exclusive, non-transferable, limited to AS400s at Authorized Locations (extra fees elsewhere), expressly bars sublicensing (Section 3(c)), and is conditional on continuing fees (Section 17(a)). The escrow licence at p0115 is contingent on Garman default/discontinued support, so it does not cure the gap. There is no provision addressing our data at all.
- **Fix (3 surgical ops):** (1) insert a licence-back after p0088 — perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Modifications and other work product created for us, plus a limitation that any Garman licence in our data covers processing solely to provide the services; (2) carve the Deliverables out of the Section 3(c) sublicence prohibition so the sublicense right is not contradicted; (3) tie the fee-conditioned perpetuity in Section 17(a) to the Section 2 licence so the new licence is genuinely irrevocable and royalty-free.
- Garman's ownership of its platform, generic tools and know-how is preserved (treated as already met), and we did not push to preferred assignment of the Modifications.
